# awscc_kendra_featured_results_set (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Kendra::FeaturedResultsSet



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the featured results set.
- `description` (String) A description for the set of featured results.
- `featured_documents` (Attributes List) A list of document IDs for the documents you want to feature at the top of the search results page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--featured_documents))
- `featured_results_set_id` (String) The identifier of the set of featured results.
- `featured_results_set_name` (String) A name for the set of featured results.
- `index_id` (String) The identifier of the index that you want to use for featuring results.
- `query_texts` (List of String) A list of queries for featuring results.
- `status` (String) The current status of the set of featured results. When the value is ACTIVE, featured results are ready for use.
- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of key-value pairs that identify or categorize the featured results set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--featured_documents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `featured_documents`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The identifier of the document to feature in the search results.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key for the tag.
- `value` (String) The value associated with the tag.
